limitations: Paper full text not accessible (subscription-only Letter, no PMC, no Unpaywall OA location); only abstract and PubMed/MeSH record read
Number of donors, disease status, age, sex and ancestry of the CSF pool not stated anywhere read
Peptidome isolation details and reduction/alkylation reagents not stated (protocol cites Hansson/Skillbaeck workflow); reduction/alkylation columns omitted
High-pH RP fractionation preceded the run but fractions were recombined into one injection; fractionation method column omitted, fraction identifier 1
Per-fraction runs mentioned in the protocol ('separate analysis') are not part of the deposit
sdrf-tools reconcile reports a false-positive cleavage_agent_unsupported blocker because it treats the reserved word 'not applicable' as an enzyme name
